description: Stop a running project or AI process by id (from list_projects). This is the stop tool to use for both kinds. The entry stays registered: a project can be started again with start_project. To remove an AI process instead of only stopping it, use delete_process. Returns once the stop is requested; call get_status to confirm.

id.description: Project or AI process ID (from list_projects)

name: stop_project
title: Stop a project
